facts.fact: Stanley Park covers 400 hectares and includes coastal rainforest, trails, beaches and Seawall waterfront views.
facts.location: Main Stanley Park overview: 400-hectare natural West Coast rainforest; Scenic trails; Beautiful beaches and waterfront views along the Seawall.
